## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-2003. The catalog-search pods were stuck in a restart loop because the liveness probe was failing before the application completed its startup sequence. The app loads a 48-shard index snapshot (taking 50+ seconds), but the liveness probe was configured to start checking after only 30 seconds when the HTTP server wasn't yet running.

The fix is to add a startup probe that allows sufficient time for initialization before the liveness probe takes over. This is a common pattern for applications with long startup times, as documented in the Kubernetes probes documentation.
